windows.notes: Posted on the venue's homepage as 'Happy Hour (2-6 PM daily)'; the page does not tie it to a specific location (Nashville or Brentwood).
windows.research_notes: Homepage text: 'Happy Hour (2-6 PM daily)', 'Half-off: Well & Liquor, Draft Beer, and House Wines'. Page undated; no prices posted. The homepage lists two locations (Nashville 5405 Harding Pike 37205; Brentwood 1640 Westgate Circle) and the hours list could not be mapped to days or to a location, so hours left empty. The venue's Nashville menu PDF (https://sportsmansgrilletn.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/SG-MENU-5-25.pdf) was opened but WebFetch returned only binary data. PDF not readable: https://sportsmansgrilletn.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/SG-MENU-5-25.pdf. The locations page and menu page show no happy hour text. StyleBlueprint (https://styleblueprint.com/everyday/best-happy-hours/) agrees (daily 2-6, half-off well/liquor, draft beer, house wines); it has no per-venue confirmed date. Searched 'Sportsman's Grille Nashville closed 2026': no 2026 closure found (the Hillsboro Village location closed years ago; MapQuest 'Closed' tag on Brentwood is unverified, and the venue site is live).
